# Task reminders

One-off or daily task notifications at an exact time via AlarmManager, surviving reboots through BootReceiver. Missed one-off reminders show as Missed at the next start.

## [exact-alarms-for-reminders.md](exact-alarms-for-reminders.md): Exact alarms for reminders, WorkManager for the rest [implemented] (52 lines)

Reminders use AlarmManager exact alarms because they must fire on time. Headlines, checks and the nudge use WorkManager and accept batching delays of a few minutes.

## [behavior.md](behavior.md): Reminder scheduling rules (52 lines)

setExactAndAllowWhileIdle when allowed, else inexact. Daily reminders add fixed 24-hour steps, so they drift an hour after clock changes. rescheduleAll runs on boot and app start.
